_comment: Example seed for <plugin-data-dir>/brands.json. Copy it there and edit — the real file lives outside this repo, at $CLAUDE_USER_DATA/amazon-us/brands.json. Keyed by marketplace profile id. Brand IDs are the p_123 facet values from profiles/amazon-us.json and are stable and global; names are for humans only. Populated from two live scrubs on 2026-08-12 ('usb c hub', 'hard case with foam') and reflects a first pass, not a settled verdict.
